C0935.title: Duxiaoman Assists Police in Dismantling a Major 'Anti-Collection' Fraud Ring
C0935.summary: In January 2024, Duxiaoman collaborated with peers in the internet finance sector to assist law enforcement in cracking down on anti-collection and illegal debt negotiation black-market operations. The case was supported by the Beijing Internet Finance Association, Meituan Finance, Ant Consumer Finance, and Mashang Consumer Finance, among others, marking a textbook-level industry-wide effort again
